## Problem

Describe the situation the framework does not address well and who it affects. Use an example without confidential or personal information.

## Proposed outcome

Explain what an organization should be able or required to do after this change. Identify the source sections, control IDs, and definitions that would change.

## Reasoning and evidence

Explain why the existing text is insufficient. Link supporting evidence and describe the effects on other controls, external agents, and the boundary of management where relevant.

## Alternatives and open questions

Describe other approaches you considered and any decisions the proposal needs. Keep proposed obligations distinct from the current requirements.
